$comment: Model routing policy (architecture §6). Config-as-code: this is the GLOBAL layer. client/ and workitem-level overrides deep-merge on top, most specific wins. Every AI call declares its capability; route() picks a tier + budget from here and records a model.routed event when a model is actually invoked. The router itself is rules, not a model — no regress. escalateOn/downgradeOn are lists: ANY entry matching triggers (keys within one entry are AND).

capabilities.$onboarding_comment: The onboarding session is Claude Code's own /init, run once per repository; what it writes steers every later session there for months, so it gets a strong default. A person can change model and effort per run, or type /model and /effort in the session itself.
capabilities.$assistant_comment: The Hebrew assistant next to the onboarding terminal: answers questions about what the session is doing, from a digest of it. Sonnet: Haiku dropped content when it was tested on the same kind of screen. Read-only; its cost is its own line in the run.
